Madagascar Cyclone Decision Game

Can you protect communities without exhausting your seasonal budget?

Madagascar Cyclone Anticipatory Action Game

Manage a shared budget to prepare for cyclones approaching Madagascar. Interpret the latest forecast, decide whether and where to preposition or distribute emergency kits, and learn about decisions under uncertainty.

Play through an unknown number of storms in a fictional season. The real storms are revealed only at the end. Daily briefings are training simulations based on WATTCH hindcasts.

Difficulty

Distribute closer to landfall, once kits have been prepositioned. The budget lasts all season.

Operational position

This is a training prototype. Warehouse positions, budgets, indicative reach, Chef scoring, and impact exposure are simplified game assumptions, not verified operational Red Cross data. Some sampled storms may not cause damaging landfall. Play the original Jokwe prototype.
